school.tagged_body:
I am a {{v:transfer}} student. I moved to this school six months ago. From my experience, I think {{t:every school should have a buddy program for new students}}.
When I first came here, I didn't know where the music room was. I didn't know {{g:how the lunch line worked|간접의문문(의문사 + 주어 + 동사): know의 목적어}}, either. These things look small, but they can be very {{v:stressful}} for a new student. A buddy is a classmate. A buddy helps a new student and can solve these problems easily. For example, a buddy can show the new student around the school. A buddy can also explain the class rules.
Also, a buddy program {{g:helps new students feel less lonely|help + 목적어 + 동사원형: ~가 …하도록 돕다}}. {{g:Making friends in a new place|동명사 주어: '~하는 것은' (단수 취급 → takes)}} takes time. Many transfer students spend their first weeks alone. Just one friend to eat lunch with can make a big difference.
Some people say that students will make friends naturally. But not everyone is {{v:outgoing}}. Shy students need a little help to start a {{v:conversation}}.
A buddy program does not cost much. It is good for both students. The new student gets help, and the buddy learns kindness and {{v:responsibility}}. {{t:I hope our school will start one soon.}}

I am a transfer student {{g:who moved to this school six months ago|주격 관계대명사 who: 앞의 a transfer student를 꾸밈}}. From my own {{v:experience}}, I strongly believe that {{t:every school should have a buddy program for new students}}.
When I first arrived, I didn't know {{g:where the music room was or how the lunch line worked|간접의문문(의문사 + 주어 + 동사) 두 개가 or로 연결되어 know의 목적어}}. A buddy could solve these problems easily. For example, a buddy can show the new student around the school and explain the class rules.
More importantly, a buddy program helps new students feel less lonely. Some people may say that students will make friends naturally without any program. However, not everyone is {{v:outgoing}}. Shy students especially need a little help to start a conversation.
A buddy program does not cost much, and it is good for both students. The new student gets {{v:support}}, and the buddy learns kindness and {{v:responsibility}}. {{t:I hope our school will start one soon.}}

essays.sampleAnswer: 주장: 모든 학교에 신입생을 위한 버디 프로그램이 있어야 한다. 근거: ① 버디가 학교 안내, 규칙 설명 등 작은 문제를 쉽게 해결해 준다. ② 새로 온 학생이 덜 외롭게 해준다.
essays.rubric: ① 주장 ② 근거 2개(실질적 도움, 외로움 감소; 비용이 적고 양쪽 모두에게 이롭다는 근거도 인정)를 모두 쓰면 만점

prestudy.tagged_body:
{{g:As a transfer student who moved to this school six months ago|전치사 as(~로서) + 주격 관계대명사 who}}, I can say from personal experience that {{t:every school should have a buddy program for newcomers}}.
When I first arrived, I had no idea where the music room was, {{g:let alone how the lunch line worked|let alone: (부정문 뒤에서) ~은 말할 것도 없고}}. {{g:Although such details may seem trivial|양보 접속사 although: '비록 ~이지만'}}, they can be surprisingly stressful for someone unfamiliar with the school. A buddy, a classmate specifically chosen to help a new student, could resolve these problems with little effort. For instance, a buddy could show the newcomer around the school and explain the {{v:unwritten}} rules of each class.
More importantly, a buddy program helps new students feel less {{v:isolated}}. Building friendships in an unfamiliar environment {{v:inevitably}} takes time, {{g:which is why many transfer students spend their first few weeks alone|계속적 용법 which is why: '그것이 ~하는 이유이다'}}. Having even a single person to eat lunch with can make an enormous difference.
Some people may argue that students will naturally make friends without any formal program. However, not everyone is outgoing by nature. Shy students, in particular, often need a little {{v:encouragement}} to start a conversation.
{{g:Not only is a buddy program inexpensive|부정어 Not only가 문두에 와서 주어·동사 도치 (is + 주어)}}, but it also benefits both participants. While the new student receives much-needed support, the buddy develops kindness and a sense of responsibility. {{t:I sincerely hope that our school will introduce one in the near future.}}

questions.q: Which best states the writer's main argument?
choices: Newcomers should learn school rules before arriving
Shy students should try harder to be outgoing
Every school should have a buddy program for newcomers
Schools should spend more money on music rooms
Friendships form naturally without any help
questions.answer: Every school should have a buddy program for newcomers
questions.explanation: 'every school should have a buddy program for newcomers'가 글의 주장이다.

questions.q: What does "let alone" suggest in the second paragraph?
choices: The writer knew even less about the lunch line than about the music room
The writer liked the lunch line more than the music room
The writer left the lunch line alone
The writer already knew how the lunch line worked
The writer ate lunch alone in the music room
questions.answer: The writer knew even less about the lunch line than about the music room
questions.explanation: 'I had no idea where the music room was, let alone how the lunch line worked.'는 음악실 위치도 몰랐으니 점심 줄은 더더욱 몰랐다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: According to the writer, how can seemingly trivial details feel to someone new?
questions.explanation: 'they can be surprisingly stressful for someone unfamiliar with the school'과 일치한다.

questions.q: What does "the unwritten rules of each class" most likely mean?
choices: Rules that the teacher forgot to write
Rules that everyone follows but that are not officially written down
Rules printed in the school handbook
questions.answer: Rules that everyone follows but that are not officially written down
questions.explanation: 'unwritten'은 '명문화되지 않은'이라는 뜻으로, 공식적으로 적혀 있지 않지만 모두가 따르는 규칙을 말한다.

questions.q: Why, according to the writer, do many transfer students spend their first few weeks alone?
choices: Because they prefer to be alone
Because buddies refuse to help them
Because their classes are too difficult
Because the school does not allow group lunches
Because building friendships in an unfamiliar environment takes time
questions.answer: Because building friendships in an unfamiliar environment takes time
questions.explanation: 'Building friendships in an unfamiliar environment inevitably takes time, which is why ...'와 일치한다.

questions.q: What is the role of the paragraph that begins with "Some people may argue"?
choices: It summarizes the writer's main argument
It introduces the writer's personal background
It presents a counterargument and then refutes it
It describes the cost of the program
It gives a new example of a buddy's duties
questions.answer: It presents a counterargument and then refutes it
questions.explanation: 반대 의견('students will naturally make friends')을 제시한 뒤 'However, not everyone is outgoing by nature.'로 반박한다.

questions.q: What does "by nature" imply in "not everyone is outgoing by nature"?
choices: Some people are born with a personality that makes socializing difficult
Students make friends more easily outdoors
Outgoing students do not need any program
questions.answer: Some people are born with a personality that makes socializing difficult
questions.explanation: 'by nature'는 '천성적으로'라는 뜻으로, 타고난 성격상 외향적이지 않은 사람도 있다는 의미이다.

questions.q: According to the writer, what does the buddy gain from the program?
choices: A new set of class rules
Kindness and a sense of responsibility
questions.answer: Kindness and a sense of responsibility
questions.explanation: 'the buddy develops kindness and a sense of responsibility'와 일치한다.

questions.q: Which word best describes the writer's attitude toward a buddy program?
questions.explanation: 글쓴이는 처음부터 끝까지 버디 프로그램 도입을 지지하며 'I sincerely hope ...'로 마무리한다.

questions.q: Which is NOT mentioned as an advantage of a buddy program?
choices: It helps new students feel less isolated
It helps newcomers with practical school matters
It benefits the buddy as well
It improves new students' test scores
questions.answer: It improves new students' test scores
questions.explanation: 성적 향상에 대한 언급은 없다. 저렴함, 고립감 감소, 학교생활 도움, 버디에게도 이로움은 모두 본문에 있다.

questions.q: When I first arrived, I had no idea where the music room was, let ____ how the lunch line worked.
questions.explanation: 'let alone'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Although such details may seem ____, they can be surprisingly stressful for someone unfamiliar with the school.
questions.explanation: 'such details may seem trivial'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Building friendships in an unfamiliar environment ____ takes time.
questions.explanation: 'inevitably takes time'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Shy students, in particular, often need a little ____ to start a conversation.
questions.explanation: 'need a little encouragement'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: Not only is a buddy program ____, but it also benefits both participants.
questions.explanation: 'Not only is a buddy program inexpensive'에서 확인할 수 있다.

questions.q: The writer moved to this school about six months ago.
questions.explanation: 'who moved to this school six months ago'와 일치한다.

questions.q: The writer believes that every student is outgoing by nature.
questions.explanation: 'not everyone is outgoing by nature'라고 했으므로 사실이 아니다.

questions.q: According to the writer, a buddy program is costly to run.
questions.explanation: 'Not only is a buddy program inexpensive'라고 했으므로 사실이 아니다.

answer: Although such details may seem trivial, they can be surprisingly stressful for someone unfamiliar with the school.
More importantly, a buddy program helps new students feel less isolated.
Some people may argue that students will naturally make friends without any formal program.
Not only is a buddy program inexpensive, but it also benefits both participants.

questions.q: What does the underlined word 'isolated' mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: 'isolated'는 '고립된, 외로운'라는 뜻이다. 'a buddy program helps new students feel less isolated'에서 확인할 수 있다.

essays.q: Explain in your own words what the writer means by "I had no idea where the music room was, let alone how the lunch line worked."
essays.sampleAnswer: The writer did not even know where the music room was, so they knew even less about something more complicated like how the lunch line worked.
essays.rubric: let alone의 의미(~은 말할 것도 없고)를 반영하여 자신의 말로 설명하면 만점

essays.q: Rewrite the sentence "Not only is a buddy program inexpensive, but it also benefits both participants" without inversion, keeping the same meaning.
essays.sampleAnswer: A buddy program is not only inexpensive but also beneficial to both participants.
essays.rubric: 도치 없이 not only A but (also) B 구조로 같은 의미를 정확히 표현하면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 글쓴이가 다룬 반론은 무엇이며, 그에 대해 어떻게 재반박했는지 설명하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 학생들은 공식 프로그램 없이도 자연스럽게 친구를 사귈 것이라는 반론에 대해, 모든 사람이 천성적으로 외향적인 것은 아니며 특히 수줍은 학생들은 대화를 시작하는 데 약간의 격려가 필요하다고 재반박했다.
essays.rubric: ① 반론 ② 재반박(천성적으로 외향적이지 않음, 수줍은 학생은 격려 필요) 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: According to the writer, why does a buddy program benefit both participants? Explain in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: The new student receives much-needed support, while the buddy develops kindness and a sense of responsibility.
essays.rubric: ① 새 학생이 얻는 것 ② 버디가 얻는 것 두 가지를 모두 쓰면 만점

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 글쓴이가 버디 프로그램을 주장하는 근거를 세 가지 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① 버디가 학교 안내나 명문화되지 않은 규칙 설명 등 사소하지만 스트레스가 되는 문제를 쉽게 해결해 준다. ② 새로 온 학생이 덜 고립감을 느끼게 해준다. ③ 비용이 적게 들고 새 학생과 버디 모두에게 이롭다.
essays.rubric: 근거 세 가지(실질적 도움, 고립감 감소, 저비용·상호 이익)를 모두 쓰면 만점, 두 가지면 부분 점수
